
{{alias}}( x )
    Rounds a numeric value to the nearest power of ten using
    single-precision floating-point arithmetic.

    Parameters
    ----------
    x: number
        Input value.

    Returns
    -------
    y: number
        Rounded value.

    Examples
    --------
    > var y = {{alias}}( 3.1415926 )
    1.0
    > y = {{alias}}( 123.456 )
    100.0
    > y = {{alias}}( 9.5 )
    10.0
    > y = {{alias}}( -2.5 )
    -1.0
    > y = {{alias}}( -0.0 )
    -0.0

    See Also
    --------
